name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.9 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 5 visits over 21 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 24 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 21 hours starting 2025-05-13, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 3.79 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
